newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Three local groups plan control of CICI.
newsitem.headline: Three local groups plan control of CICI.

text.p: Three local companies are planning to buy 91.45 percent of Consolidated Insurance Co Inc (CICI), the insurance company said on Monday.
The company told the Philippine Stock Exchange that Westmont Investment Corp, Metropolitan Management Corp, and Bulk Handlers Inc were negotiating to acquire 457,248 CICI shares.
Details of the negotiations were not immediately available, but CICI director Santiago Cua said the deal would be concluded through a cross sale on the Philippine Stock Exchange.
